title: Skills & MCP
subtitle: Manage skills and tool servers for local coding assistants.
userHint: User resources are shared across workspaces. Select a workspace to see its project resources alongside inherited user resources.
workspaceHint: Shows project and inherited user resources. Editing an inherited entry affects other workspaces that use it.
janusHint: Janus skills come from plugins. User-level Janus CLI MCP servers are read from ~/.janus/mcp.json.
saved: Saved. The client may need a reload or a new session to apply the changes.
searchHint: Try a different name or path.
emptyHint: Add a resource or expand scanned sources below to check the directories.
name: Name
skillEditHint: Include name and description in YAML frontmatter, followed by Markdown instructions. Place any referenced scripts and assets in the skill directory yourself.
mcpEditHint: Edits only this server. Saving uses the selected client's native format and preserves other settings.
skillExampleDescription: Describe what this skill does and when to use it
skillExampleBody:
# Instructions

Write the steps to follow when performing this task.
duplicateHint: Multiple resources share this name. Merge rules vary by client; check the sources to determine which configuration applies.
probeHint: Testing temporarily starts this server or contacts its address, completes the MCP handshake, then closes the connection. The result does not indicate a live session connection.
sourceHint: Scans common native configuration locations. Discovery does not imply the client has loaded these resources. Project permissions, trust settings and additional client configuration are managed by the client.
limited: The directory, depth or entry limit was reached. Some resources are not shown.

errors.invalid-config: Unable to parse the configuration. Check the file format.
errors.invalid-server: Invalid server configuration. Check command, args, url and required client fields.
errors.invalid-skill: Skills require valid YAML frontmatter with a nonempty name and description.
errors.invalid-name: Invalid name. New skills use lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens, and must match the YAML name.
errors.changed: The file changed externally. Copy your edits before canceling and rescanning.
errors.read-only: This source is read-only or contains a symbolic link. Edit it at its original location.
errors.entry-missing: The resource was moved or deleted. Rescan to refresh.
errors.already-exists: A resource with this name already exists here. Choose another name.
errors.workspace-unavailable: This workspace is unavailable. Select another workspace.
errors.local-only: This feature requires a local workspace in the desktop app.
errors.toml-layout: This TOML layout cannot be safely updated in place. Edit the original file instead.
errors.missing-env: A referenced environment variable is missing. Set it and restart JanusX.
errors.probe-busy: Another connection test is running. Try again shortly.
errors.file-limit: The file is larger than 1 MB or is not a regular file.
errors.encoding: The file is not valid UTF-8. The original file has been preserved.
errors.invalid-request: The submitted content is invalid or exceeds the size limit.
errors.read-failed: Unable to read the file. Check the path and access permissions.
errors.probe-failed: The MCP handshake failed. Check the command, address, network and authentication settings.
errors.unsupported-probe: This address cannot be tested. Use HTTP(S) and supply credentials in request headers.
errors.timeout: The connection test timed out and its temporary connection was closed.
errors.needs-auth: This server requires authentication. Supply credentials or sign in using the original client. This test does not reuse the client's OAuth session.
errors.disabled: This server is disabled. Enable it in the configuration first.
errors.unknown: The operation failed. Check the configuration and access permissions, then retry.
errors.unsafe-delete: This folder contains links, nested skills or is not an individual skill folder. Deletion refused.
errors.delete-limit: The skill folder exceeds safe inspection limits. Deletion refused.
errors.delete-expired: Deletion confirmation expired. Review and confirm again.
errors.trash-unavailable: Unable to move to the system trash. No permanent deletion was attempted.
errors.backup-failed: Unable to safely back up the configuration. Deletion canceled.

deleteSkillHint: Move the entire skill folder and its {{count}} files to the system trash, where it can be restored.
deleteMcpHint: Back up the original file, then remove only this MCP server configuration, preserving other servers and settings.
deleteSharedHint: This user resource is shared. Deletion affects all workspaces and clients using this source.
trashed: Moved to the system trash. You can restore it there.
removedMcp: MCP configuration removed and backed up. The client may need a reload.
